execution_note: Mol-1 is an open-weights all-atom biomolecular structure prediction foundation model (Apache-2.0, requiring an NVIDIA CUDA GPU >= 14 GB VRAM + cuequivariance + mol-1-base.pt). While MitoRestorer uses 11 experimental X-ray/cryo-EM PDB structures for live browser/macOS verification, these 3 JSON job specs allow one-command co-folding (`mol pred -i ... -o ./structures/mol1_predicted/`) of uncrystallized honeybee CYP9Q3 and covalent PD adduct complexes on any CUDA node.
